name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: CRM Operations Specialist | CRM Ownership, Data Labeling & Rubric-Based Evaluation
summary: CRM and sales operations professional with 15+ years owning CRM systems end to end across HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, and Accelo's own CRM/PSA platform. Personally builds and applies the rubric-based grading behind an AI-driven marketing system, including AI response configuration and the underlying data labeling, work that sits inside model-output evaluation rather than incidental AI tool use. Combines that with 15 years of CRM data integrity, sales-process optimization, and terminology fluency gained from configuring CRM, project-management, and ticketing systems for a wide range of businesses.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Configure and evaluate AI-generated response output for client automation systems, and build rubric-based grading criteria for the SEO audit process, scoring outputs against defined standards and performing the underlying data labeling personally.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize performance.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project and process records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

bullets: Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
